verdict.rationale: Tavily is a SaaS web-search API that handles user queries, so a training opt-out or no-training data policy is a fair question for it. The pack contains no evidence of such a control or policy. The only privacy-related item (tavily-docs-18) concerns blocking PII leakage, prompt injection and malicious sources. That is an adjacent control and earns no credit toward a training opt-out.
